_readme: Legacy scores for act 1 ('the market as it is'). The backend lists every address here as an UNSECURED agent until it declares on chain. First entry: put YOUR agent wallet (the one that runs `npm run attack`) with a low score — a nobody with a bond beats a star without one. The other entries are SAMPLE registry entries; replace them with real ERC-8004 registry addresses if there is time, otherwise call it 'sample registry' on stage.
